svg.aria-label: The SMK-37 Elite's panel running AISLING, each control labelled with what it does
svg.text: The four values on the screen
A pad: its effect on the whole music while it is down. It glows in its group's colour, bright while held.
> held, a pad hit: the effect stays on (its light beats). <: every pad let go.
A pad down, K5 to K8 turned: a throw of Filter, Wet, Energy or Duck.
The mix; under it, with FADER BANK lit
F3 to G5 play. White keys: the Lead, in the piece's scale. Black keys: an effect each while held.
SCALE (PERFORM): every one of the 27 keys an effect while held. OCT− with OCT+, five seconds: the update mode.
